title: Refactor plan-file slot policy (RX-F1b)
content: Plan-file slot policy: `output_path` (planner write) and `bbox_refactor_apply(plan_path=…)` (applier read) both resolve exclusively under `$BLACKBOX_STATE_DIR/refactor/plans/`. Absolute paths and slot-escaping relative paths (e.g., `../../etc/passwd`) are rejected with `error.bad_input(code=plan_path_outside_slot)`. Sibling directories `refactor/diagnostics/` and `refactor/runs/` are reserved for future phases. Implemented in `src/refactor/plan_slot.rs` (RX-F1b).
rationale: RX-F1b taxonomy: Locking output_path and plan_path to a daemon-owned slot prevents operators from pointing the applier at hand-crafted JSON in arbitrary filesystem locations, closes the arbitrary write surface Codex round-1/4 flagged, and keeps the planner/applier symmetric — a plan written here can be applied; plan-shaped JSON outside the slot cannot.
